correctness.rationale: For a proper support, deleting zero-weight edges turns the cycle into path components, and each weighted path block has rank twice the maximum-matching size; the three-state transfer therefore obeys the Lucas recurrence \(L_n=L_{n-1}+q(q-1)uL_{n-2}\). The only omitted support is the all-nonzero cycle. For odd cycles it always has maximal possible rank; for even cycles its Pfaffian is the signed difference of the two perfect-matching monomials, giving exactly \((q-1)^{n-1}\) singular assignments and rank drop exactly two. Adding that support yields the displayed \(\rho_i\). Rossmann explicitly identifies graphical-group character degrees with rank counts up to the power \(q^{n-2i}\) for odd \(q\). Independent brute-force recomputation over \(\mathbf F_3\) reproduced the complete vectors \((1,30,212)\) for \(C_5\) and \((1,36,356,336)\) for \(C_6\).

value.rationale: Cycles are the first natural connected non-tree family, and the full-support Pfaffian produces a genuinely new correction absent for forests. An explicit all-degree character enumerator directly answers a named open enumeration problem on an infinite graph family.
residual_risks: The method does not yet extend automatically to arbitrary unicyclic graphs.

final_claim: For every cycle \(C_n\), the rank distribution of its generic antisymmetric edge-weight matrix over \(\mathbf F_q\) is given by the stated Lucas-polynomial formulas with one explicit full-support correction; for odd \(q\), this yields the explicit character-degree counts \(\mathrm{ch}(C_n,i;q)=q^{n-2i}\rho_i\) for the graphical group.
limitations: The character interpretation is asserted only for odd \(q\), while the rank formulas themselves hold for all finite fields checked by the proof.
The result treats cycle graphs, not arbitrary unicyclic graphs.
